name: Fót (Hungary)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly into a blue upper hoist part and a green lower fly part, charged at the centre with the town arms of Fót: a blue shield with a yellow twin-towered church and a green mound.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
